recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If maintainers want visual parity, refresh the AllergyIntolerance diagram through the normal diagram generation path, but no normative core source correction is needed for FHIR-44517.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 Patient Care issue requesting removal of AllergyIntolerance.participant because participant/function described involvement in reactions rather than the allergy-risk assessment, with a reversion to AllergyIntolerance.recorder and AllergyIntolerance.asserter to align with R4.
initial_application: Jira comments cite GH commits ed99dff, a4fa606, and 1f388a4 from HL7/fhir#3141. Commit ed99dff directly reintroduced AllergyIntolerance.recorder and AllergyIntolerance.asserter, commented out the participant backbone, and updated AllergyIntolerance examples and the asserter search parameter; the cited commits are ancestors of the current combined branch.
additional_context: FHIR-39513 is the same AllergyIntolerance change family and records the typed participant/function anti-pattern rationale. source/fhir.ini confirms AllergyIntolerance is an active resource and includes R5-to-R6 migration hints from participant to recorder/asserter. A checked-in allergyintolerance.svg still shows participant, but the authoritative XML, examples, and search parameter source no longer expose an active participant element.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. XML-comment-stripped StructureDefinition source contains active recorder/asserter and no active participant; examples and search parameter source are consistent. The stale SVG-only diagram was not edited under the generated-diagram guardrail.
